# ScriptServerWorld

*Server*

A world (dimension) of the server, from `c.getWorld()` or an entity: blocks, entities, regions, collisions, weather, time, sounds, particles and ray traces.

## Methods

### getMinecraftWorld {#getminecraftworld}

::: member

**Returns** `World` — the Minecraft world this wrapper controls, for Java code

:::

### getEntity {#getentity}

::: member

Finds a loaded entity of this world by its UUID, see [`getUUID()`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerEntity#getuuid).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uuid` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | UUID text, like `"069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5"` |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the entity, or null if no loaded entity of this world has it

:::

### getBlock {#getblock}

::: member

Returns the block state at the specified coordinates

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) — the block state at the position; an unloaded chunk is loaded to read it

:::

### setBlock {#setblock}

::: member

Places a block state, updating neighbors like a placed block; a replaced container drops its items.

```js
c.getWorld().setBlock(scram.block("minecraft:stone"), 0, 64, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scriptServerBlock` | [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) | block state to place |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

:::

### getBlock {#getblock-2}

::: member

Returns the block state at the specified vector target

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vector` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | position; components are truncated toward zero, so -0.5 reads block 0 |

**Returns** [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) — the block state at the position

:::

### getBlockCollisions {#getblockcollisions}

::: member

Reads the block state's physical collision shape without an entity-specific shape context. Returns all component boxes, so stairs, fences and custom block hitboxes retain their geometry. Coordinates are absolute, in blocks; shapes extending outside their block are not clipped. Run on the server game thread. Does not load the queried chunk.

```js
var boxes = c.getWorld().getBlockCollisions(0, 64, 0);
if (boxes !== null && !boxes.isEmpty()) {
    c.send("Top of the first collision box: " + boxes.get(0).maxY);
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** `List<ScriptBox>` — detached list of read-only boxes; empty for air or a non-colliding block, null if the chunk is unloaded

:::

### getBlockCollisions {#getblockcollisions-2}

::: member

Reads collision boxes as [`getBlockCollisions(int, int, int)`](#getblockcollisions).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | finite block coordinates, not null; converted with ScriptVector.toBlockPos(), truncating toward zero |

**Returns** `List<ScriptBox>` — detached world-coordinate boxes; empty for no collision, null if the chunk is unloaded

:::

### createDisplayForm {#createdisplayform}

::: member

Creates a display form at a world position in this world with a random UUID as its ID. The display is not shown until [`show()`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm#show) is called.

```js
var form = scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}');

c.getWorld().createDisplayForm(form).setPosition(0, 64, 0).setLifetime(200).show();
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to display, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — display at position 0, 0, 0, shown to every player once shown, without a lifetime limit

:::

### createDisplayForm {#createdisplayform-2}

::: member

Creates a display form at a world position in this world, see [`createDisplayForm(BBSForm)`](#createdisplayform). Showing it replaces a shown display with the same ID, which can be found later with `c.getServer().getDisplayForm(id)`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | display ID, not empty |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to display, not null; copied |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — display that is not shown yet

:::

### createSound {#createsound}

::: member

Creates a sound at a world position in this world with a random UUID as its ID; it plays once

[`play()`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound#play) is called.

```js
c.getWorld().createSound("minecraft:block.bell.use").setPosition(0, 64, 0).setRange(32).play();
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, like `"minecraft:music.creative"`; resource pack sounds work too |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — sound at position 0, 0, 0 that does not play yet

:::

### createSound {#createsound-2}

::: member

Creates a sound at a world position in this world, see [`createSound(String)`](#createsound). Playing it stops a playing sound with the same ID, which can be found later with `c.getServer().getSound(id)`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound ID, not empty |
| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, like `"minecraft:music.creative"` |

**Returns** [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) — sound that does not play yet

:::

### createCollision {#createcollision}

::: member

Creates a collision with a generated ID, see [`createCollision(String)`](#createcollision).

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().createCollision().box(3, 1, 3).setPosition(pos.x, pos.y + 3, pos.z).spawn();
```

**Returns** [`ScramServerCollision`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision) — collision that is not added yet, with an ID no added collision of this world has

:::

### createCollision {#createcollision-2}

::: member

Creates a collision: a 1 x 1 x 1 box centered on its position (0, 0, 0 until moved). Give it its shape with

[`box`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#box), [`cylinder`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#cylinder), [`prism`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#prism),

[`wedge`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#wedge) or [`sphere`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#sphere), place it and call [`spawn()`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision#spawn).

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();
var pillar = c.getWorld().createCollision("pillar");

pillar.sphere(2);
pillar.setPosition(pos.x, pos.y + 3, pos.z);
pillar.spawn();

// Turns into a column of radius 1 and height 4 in one second
pillar.transformTo("sine_out", 20, "cylinder", 1, 4, 12);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | collision ID, not empty; adding replaces the collision with the same ID in this world |

**Returns** [`ScramServerCollision`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision) — collision that is not added yet

:::

### getCollision {#getcollision}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | collision ID |

**Returns** [`ScramServerCollision`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision) — the added collision with the ID in this world, or null

:::

### getGameRule {#getgamerule}

::: member

Gets a game rule; the rules are shared by all worlds of the server.

```js
c.send("Keep inventory: " + c.getWorld().getGameRule("keepInventory"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | rule name as in `/gamerule`, like `"keepInventory"` |

**Returns** `Any` — true/false for on/off rules, a number for number rules

:::

### setGameRule {#setgamerule}

::: member

Sets a game rule for all worlds of the server, like `/gamerule`.

```js
c.getWorld().setGameRule("keepInventory", true);
c.getWorld().setGameRule("randomTickSpeed", 100);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | rule name as in `/gamerule` |
| `value` | `Any` | true/false for on/off rules, a whole number for number rules |

:::

### getInventory {#getinventory}

::: member

Gets the items of a container block; for a double chest only its half at the position.

```js
var chest = c.getWorld().getInventory(10, 64, 10);

if (chest != null) {
    chest.setStack(0, scram.item("minecraft:apple", 5));
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`ScriptInventory`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptInventory) — the inventory, whose changes apply to the block, or null if the block stores no items

:::

### spawnParticles {#spawnparticles}

::: member

Spawns particles visible to players within 32 blocks, like `/particle`.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().spawnParticles("minecraft:dust 1 0 0 1", false, pos.x, pos.y + 1, pos.z, 20, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `particle` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | particle as in `/particle`, with its parameters: `"minecraft:flame"`, `"minecraft:dust 1 0 0 1"`, `"minecraft:block minecraft:stone"` |
| `isForced` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether players see them up to 512 blocks away even with reduced particle settings |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `count` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | number of particles; 0 spawns one moving along `dx, dy, dz` with the given speed |
| `dx` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along x |
| `dy` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along y |
| `dz` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along z |
| `speed` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | particle speed |

:::

### spawnParticles {#spawnparticles-2}

::: member

Spawns particles only for one player, see [`spawnParticles(String, boolean, double, double, double, int, double, double, double, double)`](#spawnparticles).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | player who sees the particles; null sends them to nobody |
| `particle` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | particle as in `/particle`, with its parameters, like `"minecraft:flame"` or `"minecraft:dust 1 0 0 1"` |
| `isForced` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the player sees them up to 512 blocks away even with reduced particle settings |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `count` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | number of particles; 0 spawns one moving along `dx, dy, dz` with the given speed |
| `dx` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along x |
| `dy` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along y |
| `dz` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | spread along z |
| `speed` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | particle speed |

:::

### spawnEntity {#spawnentity}

::: member

Spawns an entity like `/summon`; mobs get their random equipment and variants.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().spawnEntity("minecraft:tnt", pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | entity ID, like `"minecraft:pig"` |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the spawned entity

:::

### spawnEntity {#spawnentity-2}

::: member

Spawns an entity with NBT data like `/summon`; with data, mobs do not get random equipment and variants.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().spawnEntity("minecraft:zombie", pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, scram.compound("{IsBaby: true}"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | entity ID, like `"minecraft:pig"` |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `data` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | NBT data of the entity, or null |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the spawned entity

:::

### getEntities {#getentities}

::: member

Gets the entities touching a box given by two opposite corners, in any order.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();
var entities = c.getWorld().getEntities(pos.x - 2, pos.y - 1, pos.z - 2, pos.x + 2, pos.y + 3, pos.z + 2);

for (var entity of entities) {
    if (!entity.isSame(c.getPlayer())) {
        entity.damage(2);
    }
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the first corner |
| `y1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the first corner |
| `z1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the first corner |
| `x2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the opposite corner |
| `y2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the opposite corner |
| `z2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the opposite corner |

**Returns** `List<ScriptServerEntity<?>>` — entities in loaded chunks, players included

:::

### getEntities {#getentities-2}

::: member

Gets the entities whose position is at most `radius` blocks away from the point.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `radius` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest distance in blocks |

**Returns** `List<ScriptServerEntity<?>>` — entities in loaded chunks, players included

:::

### playSound {#playsound}

| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, also from resource packs |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

:::

### playSound {#playsound-2}

::: member

Plays a sound for players near the position in the master category.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, also from resource packs |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `volume` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | volume, 1 is normal; above 1 is heard from farther away (16 blocks per unit) |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | pitch, 0.5-2, 1 is normal |

:::

| --- | --- | --- |
| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, also from resource packs |
| `category` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound category: master, music, record, weather, block, hostile, neutral, player, ambient or voice |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `volume` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | volume, 1 is normal; above 1 is heard from farther away (16 blocks per unit) |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | pitch, 0.5-2, 1 is normal |

:::

### dropItemStack {#dropitemstack-2}

::: member

Drops a copy of the stack as an item entity with the given velocity, picked up after the usual delay.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | item stack to drop, copied; null drops nothing |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `vx` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | velocity along x in blocks per tick |
| `vy` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | velocity along y in blocks per tick |
| `vz` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | velocity along z in blocks per tick |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the item entity, or null if the stack is null or empty

:::

### explode {#explode}

::: member

Makes an explosion that breaks blocks and damages entities but does not set fire.

| --- | --- | --- |

| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `power` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | explosion power; TNT has 4 |

:::

### explode {#explode-2}

::: member

Makes an explosion that damages entities.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `power` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | explosion power; TNT has 4 |
| `hasFire` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether it sets fire |

:::

### explode {#explode-3}

::: member

Makes an explosion caused by an entity, which gets the kills and is not damaged by it.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().explode(c.getPlayer(), pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 3, false, false);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exploder` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | entity that caused the explosion, or null |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `power` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | explosion power; TNT has 4 |
| `hasFire` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether it sets fire |
| `isBreakingBlocks` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether it breaks blocks |

:::

### rayTrace {#raytrace}

::: member

Ray traces blocks and entities between two points; fluids are ignored.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the start |
| `y1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the start |
| `z1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the start |
| `x2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the end |
| `y2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the end |
| `z2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the end |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerRayTrace`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerRayTrace) — the nearest hit to the first point, or a missed result

:::

### rayTraceBlock {#raytraceblock}

::: member

Ray traces blocks between two points; entities and fluids are ignored.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the start |
| `y1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the start |
| `z1` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the start |
| `x2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the end |
| `y2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the end |
| `z2` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the end |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerRayTrace`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerRayTrace) — the hit nearest to the first point, or a missed result

:::

### isActive {#isactive}

::: member

Checks whether a button, lever, pressure plate or other redstone component is turned on.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the block is powered; false for blocks without a powered state

:::

### fill {#fill}

::: member

Fills a box given by two opposite corners, in any order, with the block, like `/fill`; contents of replaced containers are deleted. Large boxes are filled in one go and can stall the server.

```js
c.getWorld().fill(scram.block("minecraft:stone"), -3, 100, -3, 3, 100, 3);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) | block to fill with, or null for air |
| `x1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the first corner |
| `y1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the first corner |
| `z1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the first corner |
| `x2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the opposite corner |
| `y2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the opposite corner |
| `z2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the opposite corner |

:::

### replaceBlocks {#replaceblocks}

::: member

Replaces blocks of one kind in a box given by two opposite corners, in any order, like `/fill ... replace`; contents of replaced containers are deleted.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) | block to replace; any state of it matches, e.g. every rotation of stairs; null does nothing |
| `to` | [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) | block to put instead; null does nothing |
| `x1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the first corner |
| `y1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the first corner |
| `z1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the first corner |
| `x2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the opposite corner |
| `y2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the opposite corner |
| `z2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the opposite corner |

:::

### clone {#clone}

::: member

Copies a box given by two opposite corners, in any order, with block entity data (chest contents, sign texts), like `/clone`. The copy's lowest corner is placed at `xNew, yNew, zNew`; the boxes may overlap. Contents of containers that the copy replaces are deleted.

```js
c.getWorld().clone(0, 100, 0, 3, 100, 3, 0, 101, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the first corner |
| `y1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the first corner |
| `z1` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the first corner |
| `x2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the opposite corner |
| `y2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the opposite corner |
| `z2` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the opposite corner |
| `xNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the lowest corner of the copy |
| `yNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the lowest corner of the copy |
| `zNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the lowest corner of the copy |

:::

### clone {#clone-2}

::: member

Copies one block with its block entity data, see [`clone(int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int, int)`](#clone).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |
| `xNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | x of the copy |
| `yNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | y of the copy |
| `zNew` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | z of the copy |

:::

### setFallingBlock {#setfallingblock}

::: member

Turns the block into a falling block entity, like sand that lost its support. Block entity data, like chest contents or sign texts, falls with it and is restored where it lands.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — the falling block, or null if the block is air

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |

| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

### getLight {#getlight}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — light level at the position, 0-15: the brighter of block light and sky light reduced by the time of day

Loads or generates a chunk right away; it unloads again later unless players or tickets keep it loaded.

:::

### displayForm {#displayform}

::: member

Shows a form at a world position for a limited time, like Mappet's `displayMorph`. For more options create it with [`createDisplayForm(BBSForm)`](#createdisplayform).

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();

c.getWorld().displayForm(scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}'), 100, pos.x, pos.y + 2, pos.z);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display, which can still be changed or removed

:::

### displayForm {#displayform-2}

::: member

Shows a rotated form at a world position for a limited time, see [`displayForm(BBSForm, int, double, double, double)`](#displayform).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown in ticks; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form yaw in degrees |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form pitch in degrees |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display, which can still be changed or removed

:::

### displayForm {#displayform-3}

::: member

Shows a rotated form at a world position for a limited time, only to one player, see [`displayForm(BBSForm, int, double, double, double)`](#displayform).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to show, not null; copied |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | how long it is shown in ticks; 0 shows it until it is removed |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form yaw in degrees |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | form pitch in degrees |
| `viewer` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | the only player who sees it, or null for everybody |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — the shown display, which can still be changed or removed

:::

### spawnNpc {#spawnnpc}

::: member

Spawns an NPC facing south, like the NPC hammer; see [`spawnNpc(String, double, double, double, float)`](#spawnnpc).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of a global NPC from the NPC panel, or an empty string for a default NPC |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScramServerNpc`](/scripting/server/entity/ScramServerNpc) — the spawned NPC

:::

### spawnNpc {#spawnnpc-2}

::: member

Spawns an NPC like the NPC hammer: its respawn point is the spawn block and its init triggers run on the next tick.

```js
var pos = c.getPlayer().getPosition();
var npc = c.getWorld().spawnNpc("guard", pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 90);

npc.addPatrolPoint(0, 64, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | ID of a global NPC from the NPC panel, or an empty string for a default NPC |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal rotation in degrees |

**Returns** [`ScramServerNpc`](/scripting/server/entity/ScramServerNpc) — the spawned NPC

:::
